title: identity_record v1
description: One entry of the identity files (passwd joined with shadow), at any UID. Emitted once per entry, before the identity_snapshot of the same run_id. The engine compares the records of two passes to find created, modified and deleted accounts. Never carries a password hash: only its state. Never the keys either: only how many sshd would accept.

shell.description: Login shell as written in passwd. Empty string when the field is empty.

password_state.description: From the shadow password field. set: a hash. locked: starts with ! or *. empty: no password. missing: no shadow entry for the account. other: anything else.

account_expires.description: Account expiration date (shadow field 8), UTC. Absent when the field is empty.

authorized_keys.description: Public keys sshd would accept for the account: non-empty, non-comment lines of the AuthorizedKeysFile paths of the identity_snapshot. 0 when sshd is not installed. Absent when it cannot be known: sshd -T failed, an AuthorizedKeysCommand is in use, or a key file exists but cannot be read.
